reason: The density reduction premise is basic textbook knowledge and needs no citation. The baseline strength of HfMoTaTiZr is supported by E1. However, the key premises that Al promotes precipitation strengthening, maintains lattice distortion, and avoids deleterious phases in this specific alloy system are not supported by the cited evidence; E3 discusses Al in a different RHEA system without addressing these mechanisms, and E2 does not mention Al at all.
premises: Al substitution for Hf reduces density due to lower atomic mass of Al
Al addition can promote precipitation strengthening via fine Al-rich phases
Al addition maintains sufficient lattice distortion for solid-solution strengthening
HfMoTaTiZr baseline has ~1600 MPa yield strength at room temperature and high strength at ~1000 °C
~20 at.% Al substitution will not induce deleterious phases that compromise strength
